title: HOPE Intervention for Fitness
official: Harnessing Online Peer Education For Fitness in People With Type II Diabetes
summary: We will test the HOPE intervention on changing behavior of people to exercise more (take more steps each day).
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18 years or older
* Living in the US
* Self-report diagnosis of type II diabetes
* Has an app to track step count

Exclusion Criteria:

* On insulin or an injectable weight loss drug
